en: Vintage tinted postcard showing a grand neo‑Renaissance building with a formal garden and a central fountain with a sculpture group in front. The left side bears printed captions identifying the scene and the publisher; the top right reads "Pozdrav iz Zagreba" beside a large handwritten message in a South Slavic language. Additional handwriting and the date "15/X. 1899" appear over the image. The printed caption under the image says "Jugoslavenska akademija. – L'Académie Iugo-slave."
